gaps.prerequisites_counted: The record counts the program's prerequisite courses, which the catalog's printed total leaves out; without them the courses add to the printed total.

held.why: held: the restricted electives' figure depends on the work experience units taken, and the concentrations print totals their courses do not add to; no one kind is true for the row: a person

held: the courses add to 54.6 against the printed 'Total Units for the Major 56', and no reading closes it; this read's notes quote no second figure. total_differs is true for it and is filed only by its own procedure (kb/program_total_differs.json)
held: the major adds to 42-48 against the printed 42 (EMT 084 printed '3-9'), and the degree to 63-69 against the printed 60; two figures on one row, and no one reading closes both

held: the courses add to 54.6 against the printed 'Total Units for the Major 56', and no reading closes it; this read's notes quote no second figure. total_differs is true for it and is filed only by its own procedure (kb/program_total_differs.json)

held: the major adds to its printed 24, and the degree's 58-67 holds the printed 60 inside it, matching neither end: the units within-range kind, units_within_printed_range, filed by key once that kind is on main (d-within-range-sums-hold-for-units-kind-s739)

records.words: 'Total Units for the Major 37' equals the sum of the nursing courses only (N 010 through N 045); the prerequisite blocks (BIOL, ENGL, MATH, PSYC, SOCI/ANTH, COMM) are printed outside that total and are presumably partly counted in the 36-unit CMC General Education Requirement toward the 73 minimum degree units.

program.section_heading: NURSING: REGISTERED / Associate in Science in REGISTERED NURSING with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Coordination and Collaboration of Care: Perform within an interdisciplinary team utilizing effective communication skills, collaborative decision making, and mutual respect to promote quality patient care. (ILOs: Communication)

Safety and Quality Improvement: Devise plans of care that minimize risk of harm to improve safety and quality for diverse patients across the life span utilizing system processes. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Evidence Based Practice: Integrate current best evidence utilizing clinical reasoning, nursing judgment and patient preferences to achieve optimal health. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)

Nursing Judgment: Demonstrate judgment in practice, supported by evidence that integrates knowledge, skills, and attitudes of a beginning nurse generalist to provide safe quality of care. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Utilize the nursing process in providing nursing care. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Culture: Provide patient centered nursing care to meet the healthcare needs of patients with unique cultural attributes within diverse communities. (ILOs: Ethics)
Manage an environment that promotes patients’ self-esteem, dignity, safety and comfort. (ILOs: Ethics)

Professionalism and Leadership: Demonstrate integrity, ethical standards and principles of leadership and professional practice, personal growth, accountability for adherence to policies and procedures, and advocacy for patients and the profession of nursing. (ILOs: Personal Development)

Informatics and Technology: Manage information and technology to communicate with the interdisciplinary team, make informed clinical decisions, and minimize patient and personal harm. (ILOs: Information Competency)

The following must be completed before admission to RN program

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
